create_solvent_from_atoms: create a Solvent object by passing an ase.Atoms molecule directly
create_solvent_from_db: create a Solvent object by passing a solvent ID from the pickle database
load_solvent_with_custom_density: load a Solvent from the database with a custom density value
compute_molecules_per_volume: compute the number of solvent molecules per angstrom cubed from density
get_solvent_molar_mass: get the molar mass of a Solvent object from its atom masses
